description: Phase 3C. Exercises the masque_lifeline rung selection. Day 1 enables the experimental-families gate and switches to lifeline-strict — the chooseSubmode cascade MUST hint masque_lifeline regardless of UDP probe outcome (locked decision: lifeline-strict + masque family auto-pins lifeline rung). Day 7 burns masque_h2_connect under the 2G classifier; even if the user is in plain `lifeline` mode rather than strict, the cascade's step 6 MUST drop to masque_lifeline. Day 14 releases the burn and lifts to normal mode; the cascade returns to the H3/H2 rungs per UDP probe outcome. Day 20 the user pins an h3 override under lifeline-strict; the cascade clamps the override down to masque_lifeline (locked invariant: the strict budget rules win over override).
